text_block_list.text:
A couple of days before the most festive
night of
the year...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I return to my office to find that
someone's
decorated it for the holidays!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! Happy Holidays, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I remember she got the date for
Valentine's Day
mixed up too. Does she
actually think it's...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Tsk, tsk! I'm not wrong this time!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
We've got the Arima Kinen race on the
25th,
right? So we gotta celebrate early!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: That's what Hayahide recommended!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So that's why today, I've got the most
amazing
present for you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Saying that, she dramatically reveals...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ta-da-DAAA! A winter sports
guidebook!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
This one book covers everything from
necessities
to popular spots for the
winter season!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Skiing, snowboarding, snowmobiling... It
even has
biathlons and snowball fights!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Browsing through, I can tell the
information inside
is pretty thorough.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It has advice for beginners too, so it's
great if you
wanna try something new!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит knows a thing or two
about
sports. If she's recommending it,
this guide must
be pretty good.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I want you to go and get
reenergized!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I like all sports, so I'll come along any
time you
want!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ta-da-DAAA! A snowman-shaped cake!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
She shows me a magnificent holiday
cake in the
shape of a cute snowman.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It snowed last night, so that's where I
got the
crash of inspiration!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The whipped cream wouldn't stay in
place, so it
was pretty hard to make!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But I kept at it, and it turned out pretty
well,
didn't it? Heh-heh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
She did all this while also preparing for
the Arima
Kinen?!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heh heh! No, I gotta thank you, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: All right, let's slice this thing up!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Уиннинг Тикит picks up a knife, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uwaaaah! I can't do it! I can't cut it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
This little guy was born just yesterday...
It's too
sad!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
In the end, it takes two hours to
convince her that
the snowman would be
happier if eaten, and we
finally cut the
cake.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sniff... Snowman... I hope you're happy that we ate you...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Whether that's true or not, the cake
itself is
velvety and perfectly delicious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So yummyyyy! Thanks, snowmaaan!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Just like that, I spend a memorable
winter holiday
with Уиннинг Тикит.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After that, we look through the book
and spend a
great year-end holiday
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
